title: Preflight a structured-data file
summary: Confirm the file envelope, inspect internal record structure, and optionally evaluate explicit constraints before a downstream transformation or import acts.

stages.title: Inspect file envelope
stages.purpose: Establish file identity, integrity, structured syntax, and evidence before a data parser acts.

stages.title: Inspect records
stages.purpose: Describe the structured-data shape, record sets, field profiles, and bounded sample.

stages.title: Evaluate constraints
stages.purpose: Evaluate only the explicit JSON Schema or assertions supplied by the caller.
stages.condition: Run when input.validation supplies a schema, assertions, or both; otherwise report the stage as skipped.

completion.description: The file is confirmed parseable structured data, its internal shape is returned, and any supplied constraints have a truthful pass/fail result.

errors.description: The Procedure input is outside the portable contract.
The requested source file does not exist in the granted workspace.
The source path violates the explicit workspace grant.
File evidence does not establish parseable supported structured data.
The structured-data provider could not inspect the source.
The provider could not evaluate the supplied constraints.
A bound provider or adapter failed safely outside a more specific error.
